value.rationale: Arbitrary Boolean order ideals are natural sparse Walsh spectral models encompassing every simplicial complex and every bounded-interaction hierarchical model. Their exact integral Smith groups and modulo-powers of two ambiguity cardinalities provide precise robust structural interpolation invariants that cannot be inferred from invertibility or numeric determinants alone; the result also gives explicit inverse and inertia.
